headline: DSK Legal advises Foundry on seed fundraise

detail: Goodspeed Ventures Private Limited, dba Foundry, has raised capital from a seed fundraise Co-led by BEENEXT and Kettleborough VC, with participation from angel investors. DSK Legal advised Foundry and its founder, Ankit Jain, on this fundraise. The transaction was led by Rangam Sharma (Associate Partner), with support from Aditya Shah (Associate). Niraj Kumar (Partner), Kirat Singh Nagra (Partner) and Pranav Vyas (Partner) provided strategic inputs on the deal.
